questions: Your p. 2 says "Two device geometries, measured in three devices each, showed similar results." For each of the six devices, did the tunneling devices show the zero-bias peak in the first lobe, and did the island devices show the even-odd spacing that shrinks with length?
Why were the other four devices set aside, and how were device 1 and device 2 chosen for the paper?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: back-gate voltage outside -1.2 V to -0.8 V in Fig. 2C and 2E, field angles away from the wire axis, and temperatures for the first-lobe zero-bias peak?
What does the second-best tunneling device look like in the first lobe, for example its version of Fig. 2B and 2E?
How long is the bare InAs segment between the tunnel barrier and the end of the Al shell in device 1, and did the other tunneling devices have different segment lengths?
Was the 6.7 kOhm line resistance (p. 7) subtracted from the conductance in Fig. 2 and Fig. S3, and how deep is the zero-bias dip in Fig. S3B in units of 2e^2/h?
Did you measure tunneling spectroscopy on any device 2 island with its side-gate barriers opened, at B = 110 mT?
For Fig. 4F and Table S1, how many gate configurations went into each island's value of A, how were they chosen, and how widely do the single-configuration values spread?
